note: Generated by XDrishti.Application.Tests LiveGoldenTests from the real server calculators; never edit by hand (XD_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 dotnet test --solution XDrishti.slnx -c Release rewrites it). Money and percentages are rounded to 4 decimals, halves away from zero, as the API does; every xirr is null (not recomputed by the browser).

scenarios.name: sources-and-close-days
scenarios.description: Holdings priced by a sync, a quote and a live tick, with the previous close of the same day, of yesterday, of unknown day and none; partly and fully closed holdings; an unpriced and an unmapped one; a broker quantity that differs from the open lots'; one instrument in two accounts in different states; sub-paise prices; an older push that is ignored.

scenarios.name: push-ordering
scenarios.description: Older, equal and late pushes: only a newer price time, or the same time with another price, replaces.

scenarios.name: unpriced-and-unmapped
scenarios.description: Groups made only of unpriced holdings (no value, not zero), a mixed group, a zero previous close, an unmapped holding and a closed one.

scenarios.name: no-previous-close-anywhere
scenarios.description: No holding has a previous close: the day change stays unavailable, every open holding is counted as excluded.

scenarios.name: many-rows-sub-paise
scenarios.description: 150 holdings of 45 instruments in 4 accounts and 3 buckets, prices to four decimals, so sums of rounded rows and rounded sums can differ.
